verdict: Purchases surged this period; ROAS holds strong at 4.34.
narrative: In the last 28 days, your Meta ads delivered 35 purchases and $6,287.83 in revenue on $1,449.10 in spend, returning $4.34 for every dollar invested. Purchase volume jumped 57% week over week, though revenue per dollar slipped slightly as average order values compressed — volume is real, efficiency is the thing to watch. Google Business Profile actions dropped sharply in the most recent week, with four consecutive days of zero recorded actions after a strong 25-day run; we're addressing this now to protect local discovery going into November. Website sessions dipped modestly week over week, directionally in line with a small spend reduction on one day, and we expect that to stabilize as daily spend stays consistent around $48. Several planned milestones from August and September are past due and are being escalated this week to keep the October 31 deliverables on track.

watch_item.issue: Google Business Profile actions went to zero for four straight days, pausing a 25-day run of local visibility — a signal that local discovery has softened.
watch_item.fix: We're actively investigating and correcting the profile to restore daily engagement before it affects foot traffic and site visits heading into November.
